## Plugin reference

- Description: Debug pane listing every single-shot `claude --print` call (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus) as a live DataView — searchable over prompt/output/error, filterable by source, model, status, duration and time — with a detail pane per call (prompt, system, output or error, context, meta).
